summary: Enbridge Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on equity offering of 38,900,000 common shares at $66.85 per share, raising about $2.60 billion gross ($2.52 billion net) alongside a 5,835,000-share over-allotment option. Proceeds partially fund announced acquisitions and provide growth flexibility. Directors and officers indicated interest in roughly $1.82 million of shares. Joint bookrunners include RBC, CIBC, Scotiabank, BMO and TD. Closing expected on or about September 14, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure and acquisition funding details.
